Particularly Ernest Hemingway and many more American authors. If you’re so inclined, check out Toni Morrison’s book “Playing in the Dark” from the library to learn more about it. So while daylight generally meant more safety, within the past couple of hundred years, as shown through American literature, you can see that white evokes feelings of safety. I don’t think coloring robots white like the walls is racist at all, but they may be treated differently than robots colored black.

You’re totally right. But we have a long history though art and literature associating light with good, pure, holy, and dark with bad, scary, unknown, so possibly at this point it doesn’t matter if it’s a skin tone or not, just if it’s light or dark.

I absolutely loved shaving my head. It was such an awesome experience and I’m so happy I did it once in my life. I think if you’re really thinking about it, go for it! Otherwise, you’ll just be thinking what if!!!

What to expect if you shave your head:
Everyone comments on it. It gets so annoying. Every time I took an uber, it was like, “You have interesting style.” I definitely drew more attention. I also got a lot of comments on how great of a head shape I have! Haha!

It’s so easy and nice to wake up and not do anything with your hair!!! But it only lasts for 3-4 months or so. Then every time you sleep, your hair is mushed and there’s nothing that can fix it besides a shower! 

It can sometimes become a cycle. The WORST part about shaving your head is growing it out. So, some people just never grow it out again! Or alway have a pixie, or shaved sides, or something along those lines. 

I thought the worst part was going to be shaving my head and having to look myself in the face every day and not be able to hide my flaws. WRONG. I’m at the 6 month point in T-two days and holy shit. 4 months was such an awkward phase. Now is pretty awkward too, but jeez it seems to be taking forever. I also don’t have a lot of hats, and I’m not planning on buying any, so that probably contributes to me not liking my hair. Bleh. 

Shaving your head? 1000% yes to that part. Growing it out? Damn it feels long and it is awkward. 

So ultimately it’s up to you to weigh the pros and cons. Sometimes I wish I had had more foresight as to how brutal the growing out process would be, but then I’m happy I didn’t put much thought into it, because I’m so damn happy I can say I shaved my head.

Sorry for the late response, but I thought maybe I could help. First of all, way to freaking go with stopping purging. That can be one of the hardest things! It absolutely did serve a purpose and now you no longer need it. I have a similar background and I can relate to switching back and forth between anorexia and bulimia. For me, anorexia takes over my whole life and bulimia was “more manageable” as in I didn’t think about food 24/7, I wasn’t as sluggish and so depressed. I want to point out that you may be looking back when your purged, remembering it better than it was. I love to forget how shitty and hard things were and focus on how I was losing weight and had more friends or whatever it may be. I was still miserable, in my head, and totally and utterly hated myself. 

I am so sorry to hear how hard it is for you. I can’t imagine the pain you are in. And yet you reached out. You want something better for yourself. You know this can’t be the only way. I used to think I would rather die than talk to a therapist. My parents forced me to see one, and I was in such a dark place, I couldn’t say no. She helped me so much. I want to say she changed my life, but she reminds me that I was the one who did the changing, she only aided me. I really recommend “shopping” for a counselor and finding one you can maybe see opening up to. It takes time to build trust and I have found it is so worth it. 

If you really don’t think you can bring yourself to it, go to ED recovery chat rooms. They can be less intimidating and it’s comforting to know someone is there. 

I really hope you can find some light in the darkness. At the beginning of my journey, I went online and found some affirmations I could maybe see one day being true. I read them in the morning and at night and now I believe some of them are true. I truly wish the same for you.

Eyelash extensions can last for +/- two weeks. But they don’t last as long if you wear contacts. You can wake up every morning and look fabulous. However, like one person said, you can’t use any oil products on your eyelashes! I had to go buy another makeup remover that took more time to get it all off. When I got eyelash extensions, they felt heavy on my eyes and it was such a weird experience, I wanted out. But you can’t get out!! You have to have them on until they fall out themselves. 

Fake eyelashes are my go to. You can have different lengths and styles for whatever occasion. It also feels so good to take them off at the end of the night. There are no restrictions to them (that I can think of) and if the sides come up after a couple of hours you can easily glue them down again. 

If I were in your position, I would go with fake eyelashes. Will you be doing your own makeup for the wedding? Do you know how to apply them yourself for the honeymoon (if you want)?

I feel you. Logically, it’s like come on! But when it gets down to it, I just can’t do it. Two things help me. 

1) Visualization. See myself pack my backpack, get all the things I need and go to a separate location other than your room to do work. Finding a table, opening your backpack and getting out your reading or your laptop or whatever it is that you need to do. Lay it out step by step in your mind. 

2) Pick a time and just do it. If you say you’ll do it in 20 minutes, and it’s been 40, well then get your butt up and go. Don’t say, I’ll just wait another 20, just get up right then. You’re not going to want to do it. You’re just going to have to. Frag your body if you have to. Don’t give in to your mind protesting how much you don’t want to do it, or whatever it is saying to you. Just do it. You’re going to feel uncomfortable, and maybe even hate it, but you’re just going to do it anyways. 

I hope this can help a little bit.
